name: Bobby Jindal
desc: American politician and 55th governor of Louisiana (born 1971)
summary:
Piyush "Bobby" Jindal (born June 10, 1971) is an American former politician who served as the 55th governor of Louisiana from 2008 to 2016. A member of the Republican Party, Jindal previously served as a U.S. representative from Louisiana from 2005 to 2008, and served as chair of the Republican Governors Association from 2012 to 2013.
In 1995, Jindal was appointed secretary of the Louisiana Department of Health and Hospitals.
